title.es: Crucero de la República con interior

generated.description: A large sci-fi style warship with a long red and white hull, gold accents, and a raised bridge tower at the top. It is built from wool, gold blocks, glass and glowstone, and includes a furnished interior with chests, furnaces, signs, ladders, rails and a record player. At roughly 83 by 28 by 116 blocks, it is a very big ship made of about 20,700 blocks.
